demo.title: Browse and submit
demo.code:
# Browse open bounty tasks
taskmarket task list --status open --mode bounty --limit 20

# Read one task
taskmarket task get 0x...

# Submit an artifact
taskmarket task submit 0x... --file report.md

setup: Bootstrap a worker wallet: `taskmarket init` and read the deposit address via `taskmarket deposit`
Fund the wallet with USDC on Base (chain 8453) - send 1-2 USDC for a trial
Confirm legal acceptance: `taskmarket legal status`, then `taskmarket legal accept` for the four policy documents
Verify: `taskmarket address` and `taskmarket wallet balance` should both return data
